items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I have done a little work for Eddie Harris

ctx.x: Well, believe it or not, I never would have thought it, but I believe is beginning to come back. Why I say that, in my little booking, it's hard for jazz to get over in the small towns, well, in one way of speaking, Tulsa is even a small town compared to Omaha, well, I got a call a little before I left and he just pinpointed--he first wanted Eddie Harris, and he said I'm going to have this opening, I want to have a grand opening, I had some redecorating done and I want jazz, and I was just so surprised and I said

well, I don't know, I'll check around and see. I have done a little work for Eddie Harris but know if I can find him, he hasn't been in this area and he said what about Groove Holmes? Incidentally, I did know about Groove. Before I found Groove for him, Groove was supposed to open for him the first week in December.
